'Outside of it' in paragraph 14 referring to fetish-power.
The link from paragraph 22 to 'The success of this method' in paragraph 24.

The estimated total is close to 2700 but has not been measured by code.
summary: Cut roughly 1080 words, mainly whole optional sentences. The Rome section (paragraphs 9-15) and the modern-acceleration section (21-24) were reduced most because they ran furthest over their planned weights. All eight protected excerpts, the three cross-chapter dependencies, the hedges and the forward-pointing ending remain. Surviving sentences are unchanged except for three small repairs.
